name: Dundalk Leisurecraft Georgian Cabin Sauna w/ Porch 6 Person  | CTC88PW
description: Description This Canadian Timber Georgian Cabin Sauna is handcrafted from Eastern White Cedar , this sauna is strong for all-weather outdoor use, resistant to rot and decay, and features a beautiful light-colored finish. The door is 0.2 in ( 5mm) bronze tempered glass with a cedar frame and pre-hung on the front wall for easy installation. This sauna comes packaged in a ready-to-assemble kit . It features a 2-level L-shaped bench for up to 6-person seating and 2 front windows & 1 door window to enjoy the view outside. The inclusion of an integrated porch area offers a versatile space for cooling down after a sauna or for enjoying moments of relaxation in the open air. Features: Seats: 2-6 people Outside Dimensions incl roof: 8.2' wide x 10.1' long x 8.4' tall at peak Interior Dimensions: 7'W x 7.2'L x 7'H (353 cu ft) Wood: Eastern White Cedar Walls: 1.5" thick solid Cedar Door: Full-Sized Door with Bronze-Tempered Window Windows: 2 Double-Paned Bronze-Tempered Windows Weight: 1776 lbs Made in: Canada The Dundalk Georgian is also available in the following configurations: Dundalk Georgian without Porch Dundalk Georgian with Changeroom Dimensions Assembly Installation Manual Dundalk Shipping Policy Included Includes: Full sauna kit: Pre-cut tongue & groove white cedar for full sauna structure w/ porch Prefab 2-tier solid benches Bronze tempered glass windows Cedar roof boards Premium metal shingle roof Door w/ bronze tempered glass window Hardware Installation guide & video Heater sold separately Choose a matched heater package in the heater options on this page, or contact us if you'd like a different heater. Sauna Accessories Add a Cold Plunge Tub , Outdoor Shower , Backrests , Bucket & Ladle , Lights , Thermometer , and Sand Timer to create the ultimate relaxation haven.
